t.zh: 缩放时，新图的每个像素对应原图里的一个位置，这个位置一般不是整数：原图在那里没有像素。这一关先不管位置怎么算出来，题目直接给出。
t.en: When resizing, each pixel of the new image corresponds to a position in the original, seldom a whole number: the original has no pixel there. This level does not ask how the positions are worked out; they are given.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：落在像素之间的位置，最简单的取值办法是什么？先手算一行，再接一块电路。离两边一样远时，约定取坐标较大的一边；落到图外，取最近的边。
t.en: This level asks: what is the simplest value for a position between pixels? First work out a row by hand, then wire a circuit. When a position is equally far from two pixels, take the larger coordinate; outside the image, the nearest edge.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：照抄最近的像素，快、边缘硬，放大后成块，新图里只有原图已有的值。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: copy the nearest pixel; fast and hard-edged, blocky when enlarged, with only values the original had.

brief.zh: 这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的像素的值。
brief.en: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the pixel nearest each position.

hint.zh: 0.5 离 0 和 1 一样近；2.2 最近的像素是哪个？
hint.en: 0.5 is as near 0 as 1; which pixel is nearest 2.2?

why.zh: 这是一律向下取整：1.6 离 2 比离 1 近，却取了 1 的值；0.5 离两边一样近，按约定取 1。最近的整数是加 0.5 再向下取整。
why.en: That rounds every position down: 1.6 is nearer 2 than 1 but read 1; 0.5 is equally near both and by the convention reads 1. The nearest whole number is add 0.5, then round down.

t.zh: 位置用两张坐标图给出：x 图每格是要取的横坐标，y 图是纵坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>把数向下取整；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取最近的边。
t.en: The positions come as two coordinate images: each cell of x is the column to read, of y the row. New part: <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds down; <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read the nearest edge outside the image.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
brief.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

hint.zh: 手算时你是怎样从 1.6 得到 2 的？
hint.en: By hand, how did you get from 1.6 to 2?
